reason: I grab my Monster at the petrol station or Albert on the way to work, I'm not ordering cans online and I don't hang around in fancy cafés. If it's not in the fridge where I already shop, it doesn't exist for me.
objection: Where can I actually buy it? An e-shop and a few bistros isn't where I buy energy drinks, and at 55 CZK it's pricier than a Monster that I can get anywhere.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it in the fridge at Albert, Tesco or a petrol station at around 40-45 CZK so I could try it on my normal route.
